mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% (3-month average), or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline consecutively, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profit visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 3.0% initiates monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer spending momentum that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery, non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 150,000 jobs per month signal accelerating labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during post-recession recovery when PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate severe supply-side disruption that reduces corporate profitability, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline consecutively, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02.
